text.text_excerpt: I haven't stayed here in years so I was delighted to find it was still the same, comfortable hotel that i remembered with some of the nicest staff people around. I arrived late as the direct flight from Chicago puts you in around 11:30pm. But no problem for the desk clerk who greeted me like I was the most important thing in his day by opening the front door, assisting me with my luggage from the cab and quickly got me to the desk to check me in. I was given a great corner room! I loved the set up with the king sized bed facing the window, and the long hall behind with the closet, bathroom and sink area. The bed, as always, was super comfortable and I love the free coffee and bottled wate...

We thoroughly enjoyed our stay here for a long weekend getaway. The location is perfect. It's close to all the major attractions in the French Quarter without being right on Bourbon St. (We slept well with little to no street noise.) Everyone we interacted with was kind and helpful. The room was simple, clean and elegant. The bar downstairs is beautiful and cozy. Zero complaints, happy Marriott customer. :D

After checking in to our original hotel during our recent stay in New Orleans, we realized it wasn't up to our standards, found a room at JW Marriott, and headed over. Expecting a wait because we literally booked it in the car and arrived 15 minutes later, we were greeted warmly by the valet and front desk staff, who warned us about possibility of construction noise, given our keys, and sent on our way. Our room was clean and comfortable. There was a note saying that due to construction, the water would be shut off from 10am-3pm, but we arrived after that and didn't have trouble at all.
